identity.title: Weather Qualification Prospective Plan Freeze
identity.objective: Commit one content-addressed analytic-plan freeze (docs/qualification_plans/S10-QUAL-PLAN-01/weather_plan_v1.json, sha256 of exact bytes) for the NWS daily-rain weather qualification before prospective OOS begins: oos_start 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z, merge deadline 2026-10-14T00:00:00Z, cap 2027-02-12T00:00:00Z; frozen hypothesis, external B0, B1/B2 features, label, Firth logistic model and solver, splits and floors, power (50 target dates), fixed-sequence Brier family, DATA-03 seal/exposure rules, execution-evidence meaning and WP170 handoff, with every data-dependent candidate field a closed mechanical rule. Docs/tests only; no PreregisteredExperiment, lifecycle, QualificationCandidate, gate receipt, data, fit, score or network; WP170 remains the sole preregistration/OOS authority.

scope.rollback_surface: Revert S10-QUAL-PLAN-01 before any prospective exposure. The plan, power doc, contract and tests disappear; no source, data, candidate, gate or WP170 record exists to roll back. After the freeze deadline a revert cannot be replaced by an edited plan with the same oos_start.

api_matrix.reason: No product, venue, trading or source API is added or changed; the package is docs and tests only.

semantic_fields.reason: These rules freeze the plan identity, prospective boundary, lineage/hypothesis, B0/feature/label, model/solver, split/power, test family, DATA-03 seal, execution-evidence meaning, WP170 handoff, mechanical resolution, authority and successor boundary.

items.required_rule: weather_plan_v1.json is UTF-8, sorted-key, compact-separator JSON with no binary float/NaN/Infinity and no trailing newline; its identity is sha256(exact bytes) 1124ecfb528e5055e4193a885e89a5d9bde74df501b48a0ca4ebded8df89c46e, never inside its own preimage; the 13 sections and every nested keyset are closed.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: oos_start 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z; freeze deadline 2026-10-14T00:00:00Z judged by the GitHub server merge timestamp plus merge SHA (a later merge is OOS_START_FREEZE_WINDOW_MISSED); cap 2027-02-12T00:00:00Z; DATA-02 dates are permanently HISTORICAL_NON_OOS.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: The exact PR #200 supportive Alpha lineage and AF1 receipt are bound, the research question and falsifiable theme are preserved as provenance context, the registry is not mutated, and the hypothesis plan is nws-public-weather-incrementality v1 REVIEWED.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: B0 EXTERNAL_PIT_MARKET_PROBABILITY_V1 with spread 0.1 / trade age 86400, B0-missing rows excluded from B0/B1/B2 before label access, no imputation, unclipped B0 scoring; B1 = wx PoP12 (PUBLIC_NON_MARKET) + lead (TIME_ONLY); B2 = B1 plus mkt.ext_b0_probability_v1 (MARKET_EXTERNAL_RECONSTRUCTION); label Yes iff NWS CLI >= 0.01 inch, trace excluded.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: B1/B2 are Firth binary logistic regressions with intercept, no interactions/dropping/alternates, all-zero init, full Firth-modified Newton step, tolerance 1e-10 on max abs delta, at most 100 iterations, FIT_FAILED without fallback; SELECTION is diagnostics only; no hyperparameter search, post-hoc calibration or randomness.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: EXCLUSIVE target-date grouping, embargo 172800, label-availability purge, decision-time half-open inclusion, 100 rows per role; FORMATION >= 385 rows and >= 20 dates; SELECTION last 7 dates with >= 5 effective; OOS target 50 target dates from power 0.8, alpha 0.025, dz 0.5, rho1 0.25, VIF 1.5.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: BRIER_SCORE primary, LOG_LOSS diagnostic, absolute B2 LTE 0.25, fixed sequence B2-B0, B2-B1, B1-B0 at one-sided FWER 0.025, FAMILY_TRIAL_COUNT family size 3, Diebold-Mariano Newey-West lag-1 statistic.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: DATA-03 exposes no label value, prevalence, outcome, feature distribution, forecast, score, coefficient, statistic or result-dependent summary before WP170 OOS release; oosmembership preimage keys are exact; fewer than 50 dates at the cap is QUAL_OOS_INSUFFICIENT_AT_CAP with no extension.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Execution classes are AVAILABLE only for provenance-bound current evidence captured at or before the candidate cutoff and never represented as historical; DATA-02 CURRENT_ONLY facts stay CURRENT_ONLY; state derivation is the closed MR12 rule.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: WP170 is the sole preregistration/OOS authority: preregistered_at is the actual build time, creation_provenance binds plan SHA, merge SHA, oosmembership id, QUAL_PASS receipt id and an equality statement; search_space {}, parameters are frozen constants only, random_seeds [], split oos_start equals the literal.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Every data-dependent candidate field is one closed rule MR01-MR15 without operator discretion; synthetic values resolve the static decisions into plan bodies accepted unchanged by the existing build_qualification_candidate, and values outside a rule are rejected by it.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: Docs/tests only: no src, tools, .github, dependency or lock change; no network, data access, PreregisteredExperiment, lifecycle, QualificationCandidate, gate receipt, strategy, paper, execution, live, Gate C, capital or orders.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure

items.required_rule: On a clean merge at or before the freeze deadline return to Side14; S10-QUAL-DATA-03 is the next expected package and is separately gated; S10-QUAL-REAL-01 only after 50 sealed prospective dates.
items.safe_output: bounded pytest pass or clear pytest failure
